title: Lady Pamela II
specs: Closest fleet to Port Everglades Inlet and fishing grounds for more fishing time
Luxury sportfishing boats with A/C, bathrooms, and ample cockpit space
Experienced full-time captain and crew providing expert guidance
No age requirements; all ages and skill levels welcome
Must be 21 or older to bring alcohol on board
No fishing experience needed; instruction provided
Wheelchair accessible boats with crew assistance
Can accommodate private groups from 1 up to 60 people on different boats
No splitting of large groups; entire group stays on same boat
